description: Evaluation set for the customer chat assistant, built from SRS v1.5 (docs/SRS_v1.5.md). 'source' is the knowledge file and '##' heading that should be retrieved in the top results; 'srs' lists the SRS v1.5 requirements the answer must agree with; 'mustMention' lists facts the answer has to contain. Out-of-scope questions have no source and the answer must decline politely without inventing facts. Questions are in Vietnamese and English on purpose, because customers ask in both.
